conditions.condition_text: Identify the current Point of Interest (POI) on the higher timeframe (e.g., 4H) by observing wicks or sweeps.
The higher timeframe provides the directional context and identifies potential structural shifts.
Wait for price to break out of the previous range (defined by the swing high/low) and then pull back into that same range.
The pullback into the previous range is the high-probability entry zone for a reversal.
Enter a trade (long or short) when price retests the high or low of the previous range.
The retest confirms the structural validity of the previous range as a reversal zone.
The trade is executed during the pullback into the previous range, which is considered the highest probability zone.
The trade must be aligned with the overall market structure (higher highs and higher lows).
The stop is placed behind the entire Point of Interest (POI) or the swing that defined the range.
Targets are set at significant structural levels, such as previous daily highs or lows.
